code-a11y-check-in-ci.rule: Run an automated accessibility check, such as axe on rendered pages, in the automated tests, and fail the test on a violation.
code-a11y-check-in-ci.tool_gate: This card is the gate: axe (through `@axe-core/playwright` or similar) against rendered pages in the test step; `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` in the lint step for JSX code.

code-adr.rule: Keep a short written record for each significant design choice (datastore, framework, deviation from a pattern) that states the context, the decision, and its consequences.

code-build-hermetic.rule: Build from declared inputs only, so that the same source revision gives the same artifact.
code-build-hermetic.tool_gate: Build twice in clean containers and compare checksums; `diffoscope` shows where two artifacts differ.

code-ci-gates.rule: Require review and passing build, tests, lint, and type checks on the default branch before merge, and leave nothing mechanical to reviewer vigilance.
code-ci-gates.tool_gate: Branch protection with required status checks.

code-consistency-drift.rule: For each recurring concern (errors, config, HTTP clients, logging), make one pattern the standard instead of leaving several as equal peers.
code-consistency-drift.tool_gate: Lint rules that ban the deprecated pattern once a standard is chosen.

code-dead-code.rule: Delete unreferenced functions and variables, and the branches of expired feature flags.
code-dead-code.tool_gate: An unused-code linter in CI (vulture, knip, or deadcode); allowlist each intentional exception with a reason.

code-dependency-licence-sbom.rule: Generate an SBOM, and scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities on every change or on a schedule. Each ask is judged separately: name which one failed on the FAIL line.
code-dependency-licence-sbom.tool_gate: A vulnerability scanner such as OSV-Scanner or Dependabot alerts; an SBOM generator such as Syft.

code-dependency-pinning.rule: Commit a lockfile with hashes and install from it in CI.
code-dependency-pinning.tool_gate: Lockfile-required install in CI; dependency-update bot config present.

code-docs-refs-resolve.rule: Run a link check in CI over the docs, so that every relative link and anchor they cite resolves.
code-docs-refs-resolve.tool_gate: A link checker in CI, such as lychee (`lychee --offline --include-fragments docs README.md`) or mdBook linkcheck.

code-file-lines-ceiling.rule: Set a file-length limit in the linter (Pylint and SonarSource default to 1,000 lines), keep hand-written files under it unless a listed exception says otherwise, and split larger files by knowledge owned, not by execution order.
code-file-lines-ceiling.tool_gate: Pylint too-many-lines (C0302, max-module-lines default 1000), ESLint max-lines, or Checkstyle FileLength, with an allowlist for generated files.

code-flaky-test-quarantine.rule: Report every test that passes only on retry, move it to a quarantine with a named owner and a ticket, and return it to the merge gate only after it passes many reruns.

code-perf-budget-in-ci.rule: Write the performance budget down as a CI check that fails the build when it is exceeded.
code-perf-budget-in-ci.tool_gate: Lighthouse CI assert, size-limit, k6 thresholds, Gatling assertions, or a benchstat comparison in CI.

code-release-gated-on-ci.rule: Make a release or publish job depend on the checks passing for the tagged commit, never on the tag alone.
code-release-gated-on-ci.tool_gate: Release job with `needs:` the test job, or a `workflow_run` trigger checked for `conclusion == 'success'`; a tag ruleset with required status checks.

code-rule-has-enforcer.rule: Back each written repo rule that a type, lint or CI check could enforce with that check, not with a line in an instruction file or a repeated review comment.
code-rule-has-enforcer.tool_gate: The enforcer itself: a type, a lint rule or a CI check.

code-scoped-validation-loop.rule: Document a command that checks one package or path, with readable output, so a small change does not need the full-repo run.
code-scoped-validation-loop.tool_gate: A documented command that runs tests and lint for one path or package.

code-secret-scan.rule: Scan for committed credentials, and treat any hit as leaked: revoke and replace it first. With no scanner present and no secret found, the FAIL is the missing control; evidence is "absent in <paths>". A platform scanner (GitHub secret scanning with push protection, GitLab secret detection) counts when it is enabled on the repo and covers history.
code-secret-scan.tool_gate: Secret scanning on push (provider or pre-commit hook) with push protection on.

code-test-fixtures-built-once.rule: Build an expensive fixture once per test run, and reset state between tests with a rollback or a truncate, never a rebuild.
code-test-fixtures-built-once.tool_gate: A CI job timeout plus a slowest-tests report in the build log (pytest or Django --durations, Gradle build scan).

code-test-selection-on-pr.rule: When the full suite is slower than the pull-request feedback target, run only the tests the change affects on the pull request, and run the full suite before deploy or on a schedule.
code-test-selection-on-pr.tool_gate: A PR job that runs the affected-tests command (`nx affected -t test`, Azure Test Impact Analysis, Develocity Predictive Test Selection), plus a full-suite job off the PR path.

code-vuln-remediation-window.rule: Write down how long a known-vulnerable dependency may stay unfixed and fix or upgrade it inside that window.
code-vuln-remediation-window.tool_gate: Dependabot or Renovate alerts with a severity SLA; OSV-Scanner or Scorecard `Vulnerabilities` in CI.

code-workflow-supply-chain.rule: Pin every CI action to a full commit SHA, and keep code from an unreviewed change out of any job that holds secrets or can deploy.
code-workflow-supply-chain.tool_gate: OpenSSF Scorecard `Pinned-Dependencies` and `Dangerous-Workflow` checks; zizmor `unpinned-uses` audit.

code-workload-identity.rule: Exchange the platform's OIDC token for a short-lived cloud credential, and pin the trust policy to the workload.

fn-aria-role-has-state-and-keys.rule: When a native element cannot do the job, give the custom widget the state attribute and the keys its role promises.
fn-aria-role-has-state-and-keys.tool_gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/role-has-required-aria-props`; axe `aria-required-attr`. Neither checks that the keys work.

fn-bool-arg-at-callsite.rule: Replace a boolean flag argument with an enum, keyword-only argument or two functions.

fn-bounded-read-fails-at-cap.rule: When a size cap is reached, return an error; never hand back the first N bytes as if they were the whole input.
fn-bounded-read-fails-at-cap.tool_gate: Go lint rule against `io.LimitReader` on untrusted input; a test that feeds one byte more than the cap and expects an error.

fn-colour-not-sole-cue.rule: Pair every colour that carries meaning with a second cue: text, an icon, a shape, or an underline.
fn-colour-not-sole-cue.tool_gate: none; view the page in greyscale, or run a browser colour-vision emulation.

fn-comments-explain-why.rule: Write comments that give a reason, a constraint, or a trade-off, and never restate what the next line does.

fn-comments-survive-context.rule: Write comments that remain true without outside context: no "currently", "for now" or "see the PR", and give a TODO the date or event that ends it.

fn-confine-file-path.rule: Resolve the final path and check that it stays inside the intended base directory before using it.
fn-confine-file-path.tool_gate: CodeQL `py/path-injection` (CWE-22) or the equivalent query for your language.

fn-constant-time-secret-compare.rule: Compare a secret, token or MAC with the platform's constant-time function, never with `==` or `!=`.
fn-constant-time-secret-compare.tool_gate: Semgrep or CodeQL rules for `==` on secrets; Bandit has no rule for this, so grep for `==` next to names such as `token`, `signature`, `api_key`, `digest`.

fn-csprng-for-secrets.rule: Draw every security-relevant random value from the platform CSPRNG.
fn-csprng-for-secrets.tool_gate: Bandit B311 (`random`) for Python; elsewhere a grep for `Math.random` and `rand()` in code that builds tokens or keys.

fn-destructive-confirm-or-undo.rule: Make a destructive action reversible with undo, or ask the user to confirm it before it runs.
fn-destructive-confirm-or-undo.tool_gate: none; a test that triggers the action and asserts a confirm step or an undo path exists.

fn-dialog-focus-managed.rule: When a modal opens, move focus into it and keep Tab inside it. Make Escape close it.
fn-dialog-focus-managed.tool_gate: none; a component test that opens the dialog, presses Tab and Escape, and asserts `document.activeElement`.

fn-disclosure-hides-only-secondary.rule: Do not hide a required field or information most users need behind a disclosure that starts closed.

fn-distinct-types-for-ids.rule: Give arguments with different meanings distinct types, so a call that swaps them fails to type-check.
fn-distinct-types-for-ids.tool_gate: Type checker with a newtype or branded-type pattern.

fn-english-identifiers.rule: Write identifiers and comments in English, unless the project policy names another language.

fn-error-says-what-and-how.rule: Show each validation error next to its field, in plain words that name what is wrong and how to fix it.
fn-error-says-what-and-how.tool_gate: none; a rendered check that submits each invalid field.

fn-fetch-only-needed-data.rule: Filter, count, and aggregate in the query, and select only the columns the code uses.

fn-focus-indicator-visible.rule: Keep a visible focus indicator on every focusable element. Never set `outline: none` without a replacement.

fn-form-control-has-label.rule: Tie every form control to a visible `<label>`, with `for` and a matching `id` or by wrapping it. A placeholder is not a label.

fn-guard-uri-decoding.rule: Wrap `decodeURIComponent` on user input in a `try`/`catch`, or parse with `URLSearchParams`, so that a malformed `%` sequence cannot throw.

fn-handle-rejected-promises.rule: Handle the rejection of every promise you start: `await` it inside `try`/`catch`, end the chain with `.catch()`, or return it to a caller that does.

fn-header-value-encoding.rule: Set every response header through the framework's header API, never by writing to the connection, and reject or encode CR and LF in any request-derived value.
fn-header-value-encoding.tool_gate: A test that sends `%0d%0a` in the echoed parameter and asserts a 400 or an encoded value; Node and Django throw at runtime, which is a guard rather than a linter.

fn-heading-structure.rule: Mark every heading with a real `<h1>` to `<h6>` element, not a styled `div`, `span`, or `p`.
fn-heading-structure.tool_gate: axe `p-as-heading` (experimental) flags a bold paragraph styled as a heading; axe `heading-order` flags skipped levels.

fn-img-alt-text.rule: Give every `` an `alt` attribute: text that serves the image's purpose, or `alt=""` when the image is decorative.
fn-img-alt-text.tool_gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/alt-text` and axe `image-alt` catch a missing `alt`. Only a person can judge whether the text is accurate.

fn-independent-work-concurrent.rule: Start independent I/O together and wait for all of it; run calls in sequence only when one needs the result of another.

fn-join-dont-concat-in-loop.rule: Build a string from a loop with a builder or a join, never with repeated `+=`.
fn-join-dont-concat-in-loop.tool_gate: Linter rule for string concatenation in a loop (for example pylint `consider-using-join`).

fn-jwt-verify-pinned.rule: Verify the signature against a fixed list of accepted algorithms, and check `iss` and `aud`, before reading any claim.
fn-jwt-verify-pinned.tool_gate: CodeQL `js/jwt-missing-verification`; a grep for `verify_signature": False` and for `jwt.decode(` calls with no `algorithms=`.

fn-keep-input-on-error.rule: After a failed validation or submit, show the form again with every value the user entered, correct or not.
fn-keep-input-on-error.tool_gate: none; a test that submits an invalid form and asserts the entered values are still there.

fn-label-above-field.rule: Put the visible label of a text input, select, or textarea directly above it.

fn-length-budget.rule: Split a function that passes the project's length limit (about 40 lines if it sets none) unless its body is one simple operation or one flat dispatch.
fn-length-budget.tool_gate: ESLint max-lines-per-function (default 50), Pylint too-many-statements (R0915, max-statements default 50), Checkstyle MethodLength (default 150), RuboCop Metrics/MethodLength (default 10), PMD NcssCount (methodReportLevel default 60). PMD CognitiveComplexity (default 15) and Microsoft CA1505 (maintainability index threshold 10) measure complexity, not length.

fn-link-url-scheme-allowlist.rule: Parse a URL that comes from data and allow only `https:` (and `http:` or `mailto:` where needed) before you set it as a link target.

fn-mask-credentials-in-output.rule: Mask credentials in list, show and debug output (keep only the last four characters), and print a full value only behind an explicit flag.
fn-mask-credentials-in-output.tool_gate: A test that seeds a fake token, runs the list/show/debug command, and asserts the full value is absent from stdout and stderr.

fn-name-intermediate-conditions.rule: Name each compound condition by assigning its sub-conditions to booleans that say what they mean.

fn-native-button-or-link.rule: Use `<button>` for an action and `<a href>` for navigation. Do not attach a click handler to a `div`, `span`, or `a` with no `href`.

fn-no-blocking-call-in-async-code.rule: Never make a blocking I/O call or run long CPU work directly in async code; use the async API or hand the work to a thread or worker.
fn-no-blocking-call-in-async-code.tool_gate: Linter rule for blocking calls in async functions (for example ruff ASYNC); asyncio debug mode flags slow callbacks.

fn-no-caller-mutation.rule: Do not mutate a parameter or an object the caller owns, unless the function is documented as mutating it.
fn-no-caller-mutation.tool_gate: ESLint no-param-reassign with props true (the default props false misses param.field = value); Pylint dangerous-default-value (W0102) for a mutable default.

fn-no-check-then-act-across-await.rule: Make check-and-write one atomic operation where the state lives, and never split it across a suspension point.

fn-no-eval-untrusted.rule: Never pass untrusted text to `eval`, `exec`, `new Function`, or a template compiler. Pass it to a fixed template or a parser as data.
fn-no-eval-untrusted.tool_gate: Bandit B307 (`eval`) and B102 (`exec_used`); CodeQL `py/code-injection` and `py/template-injection`; ESLint `no-eval` and `no-implied-eval`.

fn-no-getattr-for-known-names.rule: Use plain field access, and reserve dynamic access for genuinely dynamic names.

fn-no-magic-values.rule: Give every meaningful literal a name: an enum member or a constant.

fn-no-mass-assignment.rule: Bind request data to a DTO or an explicit field allowlist, never straight onto the model.
fn-no-mass-assignment.tool_gate: A custom Semgrep rule for `Model(**request.json)`; tests that post extra fields such as `is_admin` and assert they are ignored or rejected.

fn-no-native-deserialise-untrusted.rule: Parse untrusted input with a data-only format, never with a native object deserialiser.
fn-no-native-deserialise-untrusted.tool_gate: Bandit B301 (`pickle`) and B506 (`yaml_load`), CodeQL `py/unsafe-deserialization`; a grep for `ObjectInputStream`, `BinaryFormatter` and `unserialize` elsewhere.

fn-no-positive-tabindex.rule: Write the DOM in reading order and never set `tabindex` above 0.

fn-no-prototype-pollution.rule: Never write an untrusted key into a plain object. Use a `Map`, an object from `Object.create(null)`, or an allowlist of keys.

fn-no-raw-html-sink.rule: Write untrusted text through an encoding sink (`textContent`, auto-escaped template), never through a raw HTML sink.

fn-no-shell-with-input.rule: Start processes with the program and each argument as separate list items, and never through a shell string.
fn-no-shell-with-input.tool_gate: Bandit B602 (`subprocess_popen_with_shell_equals_true`) and B605 (`start_process_with_a_shell`) for Python.

fn-object-level-authz.rule: Check that the caller may act on the specific record before returning or changing it.
fn-object-level-authz.tool_gate: Authorization tests that call each endpoint as a second user; no static gate catches a missing check.

fn-parameter-limit.rule: Set a parameter-count limit in the project's linter, and keep signatures within it.
fn-parameter-limit.tool_gate: ESLint max-params (default 3), Pylint too-many-arguments (R0913, max-args default 5) and too-many-positional-arguments (R0917, default 5), Checkstyle ParameterNumber (default 7), RuboCop Metrics/ParameterLists (default 5), PMD ExcessiveParameterList (minimum default 10).

fn-password-slow-hash.rule: Hash passwords with Argon2id (or scrypt, bcrypt, PBKDF2) and a per-password salt from the library.
fn-password-slow-hash.tool_gate: Grep or SAST rule for `md5`, `sha1`, `sha256` near a `password` identifier.

fn-redirect-target-allowlist.rule: Redirect only to a local path or to a host on a server-side allowlist, never to a URL taken from the request as is.

fn-reduced-motion-respected.rule: Switch off or replace large, repeating, or interaction-triggered motion when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.
fn-reduced-motion-respected.tool_gate: Stylelint `a11y/media-prefers-reduced-motion` from the `stylelint-a11y` plugin. A browser run with reduced motion emulated.

fn-regex-compiled-once.rule: Compile a regular expression once, at module or startup level, and reuse it.
fn-regex-compiled-once.tool_gate: Linter rule for a regex constructor in a loop, where the language has one.

fn-related-controls-in-fieldset.rule: Wrap each radio group, checkbox group, and multi-part value, such as day, month, and year, in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` that names the group, often as the question.

fn-rerun-safe-after-crash.rule: Make a state-changing operation give the same result on a second run and after a crash at any step, by deriving each step from current state and making leftovers recognisable as stale.

fn-response-fields-explicit.rule: Return a response type that lists each field, never the stored model or a generic dump of it.
fn-response-fields-explicit.tool_gate: Response-schema tests that fail on unlisted fields.

fn-specific-exceptions-only.rule: Catch only the specific exception you can handle in business code.

fn-status-announced-live-region.rule: Announce an async status message through a live region (`role="status"` or `role="alert"`), and put a `role="status"` or `aria-live` region in the markup before its text changes.
fn-status-announced-live-region.tool_gate: none; a screen-reader pass, or a test that the region exists with a role before the text changes.

fn-target-size.rule: Make each pointer target at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or space it so that a 24 px circle centred on it touches no other target and no other undersized target's circle.
fn-target-size.tool_gate: axe `target-size` (WCAG 2.2); a rendered check for the spacing exception.

fn-test-behaviour-not-implementation.rule: Assert what a caller can observe through the public interface, so a change that keeps behaviour does not break the test.
fn-test-behaviour-not-implementation.tool_gate: Refactor the code without changing what it does and run the tests; mutation testing shows whether they still catch real faults.

fn-test-oracle-independent.rule: Take a test's expected value from the requirement, not from the code under test.

fn-tls-verify-on.rule: Leave certificate and hostname verification on in every environment that ships.
fn-tls-verify-on.tool_gate: Bandit B501 (`request_with_no_cert_validation`), CodeQL `py/request-without-cert-validation`; a grep for `rejectUnauthorized: false` and `InsecureSkipVerify: true`.

fn-variants-as-tagged-union.rule: Model variants as a tagged union, and make every switch over it fail the build when a variant is unhandled.
fn-variants-as-tagged-union.tool_gate: A type checker with exhaustiveness checking (`never` in TypeScript, `assert_never` in Python).

fn-xml-no-external-entities.rule: Parse untrusted XML with external entity resolution turned off, for example through a hardened parser such as `defusedxml`.
fn-xml-no-external-entities.tool_gate: CodeQL `py/xxe`; Bandit B313 to B319 (stdlib XML parse calls) and B405 to B409 (XML imports).

inc-perf-fix-has-profile-evidence.rule: Tie the performance fix to evidence that names the bottleneck: a profile, a trace, or a USE check.

inc-rollback-path-tested.rule: Exercise each mitigation that a runbook names (rollback, failover, flag off) on a regular schedule.

mod-behaviour-lives-with-state.rule: Put the invariants and calculations that read only one object's fields on that object.

mod-bounded-fan-out.rule: Set a limit on how many other types or modules one unit depends on, and split a unit that passes it.
mod-bounded-fan-out.tool_gate: Microsoft CA1506 (95 types, 40 members), Checkstyle ClassFanOutComplexity (20), eslint-plugin-import import/max-dependencies (10), PMD CouplingBetweenObjects (20) and ExcessiveImports (30).

mod-class-size-budget.rule: Split a class that passes the project's size limit for fields, public methods or lines, unless it is a data record.
mod-class-size-budget.tool_gate: Pylint too-many-instance-attributes (R0902, max-attributes default 7) and too-many-public-methods (R0904, default 20), PMD NcssCount (classReportLevel default 1500) or GodClass, RuboCop Metrics/ClassLength (default 100).

mod-colour-tokens-meet-contrast.rule: Make every text and background token pair meet 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text), and every border, icon, and focus colour meet 3:1 against its neighbour.
mod-colour-tokens-meet-contrast.tool_gate: axe `color-contrast` on rendered components; a unit test that computes the ratio for each token pair. axe cannot see text on images or gradients.

mod-deep-modules.rule: Prefer a small interface that hides its implementation, and add a member only when callers need it.

mod-derive-dont-duplicate.rule: Derive a type, list or enum from the schema or list that owns it, or add a build check that fails when the two disagree.
mod-derive-dont-duplicate.tool_gate: Codegen from the schema, or a test that diffs the two lists.

mod-fowler-smells.rule: Name the smell, point to the line, and suggest the refactoring; do not file smells as taste.

mod-inject-boundary-collaborators.rule: Inject boundary collaborators through the constructor; do not construct them inside or reach for a global.

mod-internals-unreachable.rule: Keep a module's internals unimportable and untouched from outside it. A caller uses the public surface, not a private file or member.
mod-internals-unreachable.tool_gate: Import-boundary lint (import-linter, ESLint `no-restricted-imports`, package `exports`), Pylint protected-access (W0212).

mod-law-of-demeter.rule: Call methods on your direct collaborators, and do not call a method on an object that another call returned (a chain of two or more getters).
mod-law-of-demeter.tool_gate: PMD LawOfDemeter (trustRadius, default 1), JetBrains inspection LawOfDemeter.

mod-layers-point-inward.rule: Make dependencies point inward: surface, then logic, then boundary.

mod-no-import-cycles.rule: Keep the dependency graph between modules or packages acyclic, and break a cycle by moving the shared part into a third module that both depend on.
mod-no-import-cycles.tool_gate: eslint-plugin-import import/no-cycle, Pylint R0401 (cyclic-import), Nx @nx/enforce-module-boundaries, or ArchUnit slices().should().beFreeOfCycles().

mod-no-import-side-effects.rule: Keep I/O at the edges: importing a package must not touch the network, read files, or read the environment.

mod-no-logic-in-constructors.rule: Assign only in constructors, and put I/O, parsing, and heavy computation in a named factory.

mod-no-module-mutable-state.rule: Keep no mutable state at module level; hold it on an instance.

mod-no-shotgun-surgery.rule: Keep one decision in one module, and when a single change needs edits in many classes, move the scattered parts together.

mod-no-utils-grab-bag.rule: Put a helper in the module that owns the concept, or in a new module named after the concept.

mod-no-wrong-abstraction.rule: Inline an abstraction that has grown flags for its callers.
mod-no-wrong-abstraction.tool_gate: Ruff FBT001 and FBT002 (boolean positional arguments) catch the usual first sign.

mod-one-name-per-concept.rule: Use one name for one concept across the codebase.

mod-pooled-clients-built-once.rule: Build pooled clients once at startup and reuse them.

mod-proto-enum-zero-unspecified.rule: Give every protobuf enum a zero value named `<ENUM>_UNSPECIFIED` with no real meaning.

mod-single-writer-per-state.rule: Let only one writer change a piece of state at a time, through a single owner, a queue that serialises the writes, or compare-and-swap, never by convention.

mod-vetted-crypto-only.rule: Encrypt with an authenticated mode such as AES-GCM, and never reuse a nonce under one key.
mod-vetted-crypto-only.tool_gate: A grep for `MODE_ECB`, `MODE_CBC` with no MAC, and nonces built from constants.

mod-yagni.rule: Do not build an abstraction or capability for a need that does not exist yet; add it when the need or a second use appears.

prod-a11y-audit-before-launch.rule: Before a public launch, run an accessibility audit against WCAG 2.2 AA that includes assistive technology, and link the report in the launch checklist.
prod-a11y-audit-before-launch.tool_gate: none; a launch checklist item that links the audit report.

prod-alerts-symptoms-golden-signals.rule: Page on user-visible symptoms, such as error rate and latency, not on causes.

prod-canary-staged-rollout.rule: Roll out in stages behind a canary, and abort by rule, not by judgment.
prod-canary-staged-rollout.tool_gate: Deploy pipeline with canary stage and automatic abort.

prod-kill-switch-fallback.rule: Make a risky feature switchable off without a deploy, and exercise every fallback path in test or in production on a schedule.

prod-latency-slo-percentile.rule: Define latency SLOs and alerts on high percentiles, never on the mean.
prod-latency-slo-percentile.tool_gate: Lint alert rules for avg() over latency or over pre-computed quantiles.

prod-load-test-before-launch.rule: Load test before launch, past the expected peak, with pass and fail thresholds written down.
prod-load-test-before-launch.tool_gate: Load-test job with thresholds (k6, Gatling) in the release pipeline.

prod-profile-on-demand.rule: Make a CPU and memory profile of a production instance obtainable, through a continuous profiler or a private profile endpoint.

prod-shadow-compare-before-cutover.rule: Before you move traffic to a new system, run it beside the old one on live or captured production traffic, diff the results, and cut over only when every mismatch is fixed or explained.

prod-slo-error-budget.rule: Define an SLO with an indicator and window, and use its remaining error budget to gate risky releases.

svc-account-linking.rule: Link a federated identity to an existing account only after proving control of both, and key the link on the pair `iss` and `sub`, never on an unverified email or another profile claim.

svc-api-cache-control.rule: Set an explicit `Cache-Control` on every response a cache may store, use `private` or `no-store` for user-specific data, add `Vary` for any request header that changes the body, keep the origin's `Cache-Control` authoritative at the edge (no minimum TTL or force-cache override), and decide cacheability by the response `Content-Type`, not the URL extension.
svc-api-cache-control.tool_gate: Integration test or header lint that rejects a 200 GET without `Cache-Control`.

svc-api-conditional-writes.rule: Return an `ETag` on reads and honour `If-Match` on writes, answering 412 when the entity tag is stale.
svc-api-conditional-writes.tool_gate: Integration test that sends a write with a stale `If-Match` and expects 412.

svc-api-contract-tests.rule: Run a contract test for each cross-service call, derived from the consumer's real requests, and fail the provider's build when it breaks one.
svc-api-contract-tests.tool_gate: Contract test run in CI for both sides, and a gate that blocks deploy when a consumer's contract fails against the provider.

svc-api-deprecation-sunset.rule: Before removing an endpoint, mark it `deprecated` in the spec and send `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers.
svc-api-deprecation-sunset.tool_gate: Middleware that adds both headers for routes tagged deprecated; a spec linter on `deprecated: true` without a sunset date; a dashboard counting calls that carry the headers.

svc-api-documented-errors.rule: Document every error status each operation can return, with a schema and one example.
svc-api-documented-errors.tool_gate: Spec linter that requires 4xx and 5xx responses with a schema on every operation, and an example on each.

svc-api-error-code-stable.rule: Give each error a stable machine-readable code that callers branch on, and never make them parse the message text.
svc-api-error-code-stable.tool_gate: Spec linter that requires an enumerated error `type` or `reason` per operation; a test that pins the codes.

svc-api-key-scope.rule: Issue each API key with the narrowest scopes and a bounded lifetime, and rotate or revoke it after any exposure.

svc-api-naming-consistent.rule: Use one casing convention per location (fields, query parameters, headers, paths) across the whole API, and state it in the API guide.
svc-api-naming-consistent.tool_gate: Spec linter with a casing rule per location.

svc-api-problem-json.rule: Return errors as `application/problem+json` with a `status` that equals the HTTP status, and leave stack traces and internal detail out.
svc-api-problem-json.tool_gate: Middleware that builds every error body from one problem-details type; a test that fails on an error response without the media type.

svc-api-retry-after.rule: Send `Retry-After` on every 429 and 503, and set it no earlier than the time capacity returns.
svc-api-retry-after.tool_gate: Integration test that forces a 429 and a 503 and asserts a `Retry-After` header.

svc-api-specific-status-codes.rule: Return the most specific status code that fits: 201 with `Location` for a create, 405 with `Allow` for a wrong method, and a 4xx or 5xx for any failure.
svc-api-specific-status-codes.tool_gate: Integration tests asserting status and headers per operation; a spec linter for 201 and 405 responses.

svc-api-versioning-policy.rule: Write down one versioning scheme for the API, and ship no breaking change inside a version it has published.
svc-api-versioning-policy.tool_gate: Spec diff in CI that fails on a breaking change inside a published version.

svc-async-content-reserves-space.rule: Reserve the space for late-loading content with set dimensions or an aspect ratio, so nothing already on screen moves.

svc-auth-throttle-generic-errors.rule: Limit failed attempts per account, and return the same message and status code whether or not the account exists.
svc-auth-throttle-generic-errors.tool_gate: Rate-limit middleware on auth routes; test that known and unknown users get identical responses.

svc-authn-by-default.rule: Require authentication on every route by default, and mark each public route by name.
svc-authn-by-default.tool_gate: A framework fallback that requires authentication (ASP.NET Core `FallbackPolicy`, Django `LoginRequiredMiddleware`, Spring Security `anyRequest().authenticated()`); a test that calls every route without credentials and expects 401 or a login redirect unless the route is on the public list.

svc-authz-central-deny-default.rule: Route every request through one authorization layer that denies when no rule allows it.
svc-authz-central-deny-default.tool_gate: Router that denies routes with no policy; a test that lists every route and its required role.

svc-best-effort-optional-deps.rule: Give each call to a non-critical dependency a short budget and a default, so its failure degrades the result instead of failing the critical path, and count every fallback.

svc-bound-client-controlled-sizes.rule: Cap every client-controlled size and count on the server: body bytes, string length, array items, page size and batch size.
svc-bound-client-controlled-sizes.tool_gate: Gateway request-size limit; schema `maxLength`/`maxItems`; test with a 10 MB body and `limit=1000000`.

svc-bounded-background-tasks.rule: Cap how many background tasks run at once, and never spawn one per input with no limit.

svc-cache-key-completeness.rule: Key every request input that can change the response, and strip any other request value before it reaches a cached body.
svc-cache-key-completeness.tool_gate: A test that sends an unkeyed header or a GET body and asserts the response body does not change.

svc-circuit-breaker-bulkhead.rule: Give each critical dependency its own concurrency limit.

svc-cli-destructive-dry-run.rule: Give a destructive command a preview flag that changes nothing and a flag that skips the confirmation prompt.
svc-cli-destructive-dry-run.tool_gate: CLI test that runs the command with the preview flag and checks nothing changed.

svc-cli-exit-codes-and-streams.rule: Exit non-zero when a command fails, and write results to stdout and errors and progress to stderr.
svc-cli-exit-codes-and-streams.tool_gate: CLI test that runs a failing command and checks the exit code and that stdout is empty.

svc-cli-non-interactive.rule: Let the caller turn every prompt off with a flag or an environment variable, so the command never waits on a terminal.
svc-cli-non-interactive.tool_gate: CLI test that runs every command with stdin closed.

svc-cors-allowlist.rule: Allow cross-origin access only to a fixed list of named origins, and never echo the request `Origin` header back unchecked.
svc-cors-allowlist.tool_gate: Integration test that sends a hostile `Origin` and asserts it is not echoed.

svc-csp-strict-script-src.rule: Send a `Content-Security-Policy` whose `script-src` uses a per-response nonce or script hashes, with `object-src 'none'` and `base-uri 'none'`.
svc-csp-strict-script-src.tool_gate: Google CSP Evaluator on the policy; a CI header check against a staging URL.

svc-csrf-state-changing.rule: Require a CSRF token (or an equivalent header check) on every cookie-authenticated request that changes state, and never change state on GET.
svc-csrf-state-changing.tool_gate: Framework CSRF middleware enabled; test that a POST without the token returns 403.

svc-decompression-cap.rule: Cap the decompressed output of every decoder, and set the cap on the output rather than the compressed input.
svc-decompression-cap.tool_gate: Apache `DeflateInflateLimitRequestBody`; ASP.NET Core `MaxRequestBodySize`; a test that inflates a 1 MB gzip to about 1 GB and asserts the decoder stops at the cap.

svc-dlq.rule: Give every consumer queue a dead-letter queue and keep a way to replay it after the fix. On an ordered queue, key the group or session to the unit that must stay ordered, so a poison message holds only its own unit.
svc-dlq.tool_gate: A config check that every consumed queue has a dead-letter target (for SQS in Terraform, a `redrive_policy` with `maxReceiveCount`), and an alarm on dead-letter queue depth.

svc-export-scope.rule: Scope an export to what the requesting principal may read.
svc-export-scope.tool_gate: A test that exports as a second tenant and asserts the other tenant's rows are absent.

svc-fail-closed-defaults.rule: Ship every security control switched on, with an empty allow-list denying everything.
svc-fail-closed-defaults.tool_gate: A startup check that raises on a missing or placeholder secret (Django refuses an unset `SECRET_KEY`; Pydantic Settings fields without a default); a test that boots the service with an empty environment and expects a failed start or denied requests.

svc-host-header-trust.rule: Build absolute URLs from configured values, answer only for a `Host` on an allowlist, and take `X-Forwarded-*` values only from a trusted proxy.
svc-host-header-trust.tool_gate: Framework host allowlist configured (`ALLOWED_HOSTS`, `AllowedHosts`, `config.hosts`, `trustHosts`), and a test that sends a hostile `Host` and expects 400.

svc-idempotency-key.rule: Make every retryable write idempotent: the caller sends a unique key, and a retry with the same key never applies the write twice.

svc-invalid-input-is-4xx.rule: Check each caller-supplied value against its allowed domain (range, allowed set, an id that must exist, an encoding the code can handle) at the boundary, and answer a failed check with a 4xx, never a 5xx.
svc-invalid-input-is-4xx.tool_gate: Schema or model constraints on every field (minimum, maximum, enum, format); a test that posts a negative number, an unknown id and a non-ASCII header and expects a 4xx.

svc-list-endpoint-paginates.rule: Paginate every list endpoint, with a default page size and a server-side maximum.
svc-list-endpoint-paginates.tool_gate: Contract test that calls the list with a huge page size and asserts the clamp or a 400.

svc-mfa-step-up.rule: Require a fresh authentication with an already-bound factor before sensitive actions and before adding, replacing or removing an MFA factor; an existing session alone is not enough.

svc-no-redundant-entry.rule: Do not ask for information the user already gave in the same flow. Fill it in, or let the user pick it.
svc-no-redundant-entry.tool_gate: none; a walk through the flow that lists each field asked twice.

svc-no-secrets-in-url.rule: Send tokens, keys, passwords, and personal data in a header or the request body, never in the path or query string.

svc-oauth-code-flow-binding.rule: Finish the authorization-code flow with PKCE and a challenge method that keeps the verifier out of the authorization request (`S256`), send the exact registered `redirect_uri` (a native app on the loopback interface may vary the port), and reject the response unless this transaction's `state` or OIDC `nonce` matches and the ID token's signature, `iss`, `aud` and `exp` check out.

svc-password-reset.rule: Make the reset token single-use and short-lived, and on success revoke every session.

svc-rate-limit-quota.rule: Enforce a per-tenant quota on shared APIs and queues.

svc-reflow-and-zoom.rule: Make the page usable at 320 CSS pixels wide and at 200% text zoom, with no sideways scrolling, no clipped content, and no blocked pinch-zoom.
svc-reflow-and-zoom.tool_gate: axe `meta-viewport`; a rendered check at a 320 px viewport and at 200% text zoom.

svc-request-framing.rule: Reject a request that carries both `Transfer-Encoding` and `Content-Length`, or remove one field at the first hop, and parse header framing strictly rather than with a leniency flag.
svc-request-framing.tool_gate: A test that sends one request with both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding and expects 400 or a closed connection.

svc-retry-policy.rule: Retry only transient errors, with capped attempts and jittered exponential backoff.

svc-saga-steps.rule: Make steps after the pivot idempotent and retryable, and make every compensation idempotent with a failure path.

svc-saml-assertion-binding.rule: Verify the XML signature over the assertion you read, with the IdP's configured key rather than a key carried in the response, then require the assertion's `Audience` and its bearer `SubjectConfirmationData` `Recipient` to name this SP, the response `Destination` to be this endpoint, `InResponseTo` to match your request (absent for an IdP-initiated response), `NotOnOrAfter` to be current, and the assertion ID to be unseen. These are one step, verify the assertion, and each check is cited.

svc-session-lifecycle.rule: Issue a new session ID at login, and set `Secure`, `HttpOnly` and `SameSite` on the session cookie.
svc-session-lifecycle.tool_gate: Header test on the login response; session fixation test in the end-to-end suite.

svc-slow-operation-shows-progress.rule: Show that a slow action is under way, and show its progress when it runs long.
svc-slow-operation-shows-progress.tool_gate: none; throttle the network and run the action.

svc-soft-delete-default.rule: Filter soft-deleted rows out of every read path by default, and make a read that includes them an explicit call.
svc-soft-delete-default.tool_gate: A test per read path: soft-delete a row, then assert the endpoint returns 404 or leaves it out of the list.

svc-sqli-authn.rule: Pass untrusted data to queries as bound parameters, never by string concatenation or formatting.

svc-stream-dont-materialise.rule: Process large results as a stream with backpressure; do not load them whole into memory.
svc-stream-dont-materialise.tool_gate: Memory limit in tests with a large fixture.

svc-tenant-id-in-telemetry.rule: Put the verified tenant id on every tenant-scoped log, metric and audit record.
svc-tenant-id-in-telemetry.tool_gate: A test that writes an event for each of two tenants, then queries one tenant and asserts the other is absent.

svc-timeouts.rule: Set an explicit timeout on every remote call.

svc-tls-modern-only.rule: Accept only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 on servers.
svc-tls-modern-only.tool_gate: testssl.sh or a similar scan against the public endpoint in CI; the load balancer's named security policy checked in config review.

svc-update-rollback-on-failure.rule: When an update fails, restore the previous version instead of leaving a missing or half-written one.
svc-update-rollback-on-failure.tool_gate: Test that makes the final step fail and checks the old version still runs.

svc-update-verify-provenance.rule: Verify a downloaded update against a signature, an attestation or a pinned key, or against a checksum that reached you by another route than the file; a checksum fetched from the same host as the file does not count.

svc-upload-validate-store.rule: Allowlist the file type, cap the size, and store each upload under a generated name where the server will not execute it.
svc-upload-validate-store.tool_gate: Upload tests with a renamed `.php`, an oversized file and a zip bomb.

svc-webhook-replay-window.rule: Reject an inbound signed message whose creation time is outside a short tolerance, and sign that time with the body so it cannot be swapped.
svc-webhook-replay-window.tool_gate: A test that replays a captured request with the timestamp moved outside the tolerance and asserts a 4xx, and one that changes only the timestamp header and asserts a 4xx.

sys-agent-tool-least-privilege.rule: Give the agent only the narrow tools and the minimal credentials its task needs.
sys-agent-tool-least-privilege.tool_gate: Tool registry reviewed in code; downstream credentials scoped in IAM and tested as the agent identity.

sys-cache-bounds-invalidation.rule: Bound every cache by size and give its entries an expiry.

sys-cells-limit-blast-radius.rule: Split shared infrastructure into independent cells, each with its own control plane and storage, and route each tenant or request to one cell, so one failure stops only that cell.

sys-consistent-ui-terms.rule: Use one label and one icon for the same action and the same concept across all screens.
sys-consistent-ui-terms.tool_gate: none; list the labels and icons for one action across all screens.

sys-fanout-leg-deadlines.rule: Give every leg of a fan-out its own deadline, and decide in code what happens when a leg misses it: a partial result, a hedged request, or an error.

sys-health-liveness-readiness.rule: Wire load balancers and restarters to liveness and local checks only, never to shared-dependency checks.

sys-index-concurrently.rule: Create indexes with `CONCURRENTLY`, outside a transaction block, and handle a failed build that leaves an INVALID index.

sys-load-shedding-bounded-queues.rule: Bound every queue and reject excess work cheaply.

sys-lock-fencing.rule: Check a correctness lock on the resource side (fencing token or compare-and-set), never by lock possession alone.

sys-migration-expand-contract.rule: Run data backfills in batches, in a migration separate from the schema change.

sys-migration-lock-timeout.rule: Set `lock_timeout` for the migration session and retry on timeout.
sys-migration-lock-timeout.tool_gate: Migration linter (e.g. flag ALTER without lock_timeout).

sys-n-plus-one-pooling.rule: Fetch related rows in one query or batch, never one query per row.
sys-n-plus-one-pooling.tool_gate: Query-count assertion in tests; ORM N+1 detector.

sys-pii-minimise-retention.rule: Give every store of personal or sensitive data a retention period, and delete or anonymise the data when it ends.
sys-pii-minimise-retention.tool_gate: Retention jobs with a TTL on tables and buckets; a data inventory checked in CI.

sys-prompt-injection.rule: Validate model output deterministically before code acts on it.

sys-secrets-and-errors.rule: Fail closed: a validation or auth error must deny, never continue, and an error response must not carry internals such as stack traces, SQL or tokens.
sys-secrets-and-errors.tool_gate: Secret scanner in CI; log-redaction tests.

sys-ssrf.rule: Fetch a user-supplied URL only when its host matches a server-side allowlist.
sys-ssrf.tool_gate: CodeQL `py/full-ssrf`; an egress proxy or firewall allowlist.

chg-agent-grounded-code.rule: Verify that every import and external call the agent wrote exists with that signature.
chg-agent-grounded-code.tool_gate: Compiler, type checker and dependency-resolution in CI catch non-existent imports and calls.

chg-agent-independent-review.rule: Get sign-off from a person or a fresh-context reviewer who has the spec but not the author's reasoning; self-review by the writing session does not count.

chg-approval-tied-to-patch.rule: Treat an approval or verification verdict as current only if the patch is unchanged: compare `git patch-id` at the verdict commit with the current head. If the patches differ only in tests, docs, or lint config, the verdict can stand when the built output is the same; any other difference needs a fresh check.
chg-approval-tied-to-patch.tool_gate: Branch protection that dismisses stale approvals on new commits.

chg-author-hygiene.rule: Self-review the diff and write the description before requesting review.
chg-author-hygiene.tool_gate: PR template with required sections; branch protection requiring green CI.

chg-breaking-change-taxonomy.rule: Treat any change that callers can observe in a signature, return values, error types, defaults, or side effects as breaking until a consumer check says otherwise.

chg-chestertons-fence.rule: Add a characterization test before rewriting code you do not understand.

chg-delete-legacy-after-migration.rule: When no consumer sits outside the repo, move every caller to the new API and delete the old one, and the tests that pinned its internals, in the same change.

chg-devex-breaking-config.rule: Flag a change that renames or removes an environment variable, moves a secret, or remaps a port as breaking for developers and operators, and update every place that documents or sets it.
chg-devex-breaking-config.tool_gate: Startup check that fails fast on missing or unknown config keys.

chg-expand-contract.rule: Evolve shared contracts in steps: add the new form beside the old (expand), migrate every consumer, then remove the old form (contract) in a later change.
chg-expand-contract.tool_gate: Schema or API diff tools (breaking-change detectors) in CI.

chg-match-codebase-pattern.tool_gate: Repeated style nits mean a missing linter or formatter rule; add the gate instead of commenting.

chg-migration-add-column-rewrite.rule: Add the column nullable or with a constant default, then fill volatile, computed, or identity values in batches.
chg-migration-add-column-rewrite.tool_gate: Migration linter that flags volatile defaults, stored generated columns and identity columns on ADD COLUMN.

chg-name-attack-surface.rule: List any new attack surface in the description.
chg-name-attack-surface.tool_gate: SAST and dependency scanning in CI catch the mechanical part.

chg-no-silenced-diagnostics.rule: Name the rule, the reason, and a ticket on every suppression; a swallowed error, skipped test, or disabled check is a FAIL unless justified.
chg-no-silenced-diagnostics.tool_gate: Linter rule that requires a reason and ticket on each suppression.

chg-no-special-case-branches.rule: Put a new case behind its own function or type; do not add a one-off branch to a shared flow.
chg-no-special-case-branches.tool_gate: Microsoft CA1502 (cyclomatic complexity, default 25) or PMD CognitiveComplexity (default 15) on the shared function.

chg-one-concern.rule: Make each change do one logical thing; if the description needs "and" between unrelated outcomes, split it.
chg-one-concern.tool_gate: A CI check can label or warn on file count and diff size.

chg-perf-claim-evidence.rule: Back a performance claim with measured before-and-after numbers.

chg-proto-no-field-type-change.rule: Never change the type of a protobuf field, switch it between repeated and scalar, or rename it while any consumer reads JSON or text format; add a new field instead.
chg-proto-no-field-type-change.tool_gate: `buf breaking` with the wire and JSON rule sets.

chg-proto-reserve-removed-fields.rule: When you delete a protobuf field or enum value, add `reserved` for its number and name in the same change, and never reuse a number.
chg-proto-reserve-removed-fields.tool_gate: `buf breaking` or an equivalent descriptor diff in CI.

chg-refactor-has-behaviour-pin.rule: Pin current behaviour with a characterization test, snapshot or equivalence check before the refactor moves any structure.
chg-refactor-has-behaviour-pin.tool_gate: Snapshot or golden-file tests in CI.

chg-refactor-separate.rule: Put refactors, renames, and reformatting in their own commit or PR, apart from behaviour changes.
chg-refactor-separate.tool_gate: A formatter check in CI removes the reformatting case.

chg-reuse-before-write.rule: Do not add a helper that duplicates one already in the repo; search for it first.
chg-reuse-before-write.tool_gate: Clone-detection in CI (jscpd, PMD CPD, or similar) can flag near-duplicate blocks.

chg-review-signal.rule: Do not spend review comments on what a tool enforces or on minor style points; spend them on the findings that matter.
chg-review-signal.tool_gate: Formatter, linter and type checker own style and mechanical rules.

chg-rollback-path.rule: State in the description how to undo the change.
chg-rollback-path.tool_gate: Migration linter requiring a down step; deploy pipeline with automatic abort.

chg-size-ceiling.rule: Split a change past about 400 changed lines or about 20 files, or say in the description why not; aim for about 200.
chg-size-ceiling.tool_gate: Size labels or a diff-size warning in CI.

chg-tests-ship-with-change.rule: Ship new or changed behaviour in the same change as a test that fails if the behaviour breaks.
chg-tests-ship-with-change.tool_gate: Coverage-delta or "changed source without changed tests" check in CI.

chg-ui-change-screenshots-and-keyboard-p.rule: A UI change shows before-and-after screenshots and says what a keyboard-only pass and a 200% zoom check found on the changed screens.
chg-ui-change-screenshots-and-keyboard-p.tool_gate: A pull request template with a UI checklist; the screenshots and the keyboard result are the evidence.

chg-verify-before-claim.rule: Back every "works" or "bug" claim with something run: a repro, a test or command output.

py-cancellation.rule: Re-raise `CancelledError` (do not catch it via bare `except` or `BaseException`), and catch `TimeoutError` outside the `asyncio.timeout()` block.
py-cancellation.tool_gate: Ruff BLE001 / S110 for broad swallow; lint for CancelledError needs custom rule.

py-class-earns-its-instance.rule: Give a class real state or a collaborator; otherwise write a module function.
py-class-earns-its-instance.tool_gate: ruff PLR6301 (partial), Pylint R0903 (min-public-methods=2, dataclasses exempt; it counts public methods, not state, so a static-only class with two methods passes)

py-docstrings-google.rule: Write a Google-style docstring only when it adds what the signature cannot say.

py-field-only-when-adds.rule: Use `Field()` only when it adds something (a constraint, an alias, or API docs), and set plain defaults directly.

py-httpx-client-lifespan.rule: Pass an explicit `httpx.Timeout` to every `httpx` client.

py-imports.rule: Put imports at module top, absolute only.

py-modern-typing.rule: Write `X | None` and builtin generics, not `typing` aliases.

py-no-cast.rule: Do not use `cast()`; parse the boundary into a typed model, or narrow with `isinstance`.

py-no-init-or-model-tests.rule: Cover `__init__` and plain models through the behaviour that uses them.

py-paths-from-file.rule: Resolve paths from `__file__`, not the current working directory.

py-pytest-expensive-fixture-scope.rule: Give an expensive pytest fixture `scope="session"` or `"module"` and isolate each test with a rollback, never a schema build or a seed load inside a function-scoped fixture.
py-pytest-expensive-fixture-scope.tool_gate: pytest --durations=10 --durations-min=1.0 to find the fixture, and a CI job timeout to hold the line.

py-pytest-parametrize.rule: Write tests that differ only in inputs and expected values as one `@pytest.mark.parametrize` test.

py-ruff-gate.rule: Enable the Ruff rule sets E, F, I, B, UP, SIM, BLE, TID and D in CI.

py-task-reference.rule: Never discard the result of `create_task`; keep a reference and surface its exceptions, preferably through a `TaskGroup`.

py-test-hygiene.rule: Keep unit tests off external I/O (the network, the shared filesystem and the database) and off the real clock, and run tests that need them in a separate, slower tier.
py-test-hygiene.tool_gate: pytest-socket (`--disable-socket`), plus a unit-test CI job with no database service and no network credentials

py-xdist-worker-isolated-state.rule: Under pytest-xdist, give each worker its own database or other mutable resource, keyed by `worker_id`, and build an expensive shared one once with a lock file.
